title: Rate mat batao. *Bijli ka bill* maango.
message:
Namaste [naam] ☀️ sahi quote ke liye apne *pichle bijli bill ki photo* bhej dijiye.
Usse batayenge: kitne kW, kitna kharcha, aur *subsidy ke baad* kitna bachega.
24 ghante mein estimate.
why: bill ki photo bhejne wala *serious buyer* hai. Aur estimate unke apne bill pe = trust.
caption:
Solar ki har enquiry "kitna kharcha?" se shuru hoti hai. Ek general rate bhejo to customer 5 installers se compare karta hai. ☀️

Behtar:
1️⃣ Bijli bill ki photo maango
2️⃣ Unke bill pe kW + kharcha + bachat
3️⃣ 24 ghante mein estimate PDF
4️⃣ Site survey ka slot

Jo bill bhejta hai, wahi asli buyer hai. Save karo 🔖
